Experimental_Design.Conditions: 3 (cue identity: You label, own-face name, stranger name) x 3 (target identity: self-associated face, own face, stranger face) within-subjects; each cue followed by each target with equal probability (33.3%)

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: Label: 200 ms; Face: until response (max 2000 ms)
Trial_Structure.SOA: 1200 ms (label onset to face onset; 1 s delay between label offset and face onset)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Faces: participant's own photograph + two Chicago Face Database faces (one arbitrarily associated with the self via the label 'You', one associated with a stranger's name); total picture 8 deg x 8 deg, face alone approx. 3.8 deg x 5.3 deg; the label 'You' always paired with a database face, the own face always paired with a stranger's name (names as in Exp1: Pam/Meg or Rob/Sam, changed to Kat/Ken if coinciding); assignment counterbalanced across participants
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Names of equal length (3 letters, width 2 deg)

exp3.detail: Experiment 3: simultaneous establishment of both associations - a stranger's face with the label 'You' (self-associated) and the participant's own real face with a stranger's name. 25 participants tested, 1 excluded due to technical issues with the stimuli; 24 analyzed (12 Asian-face and 12 White-face versions; 12 female/12 male; age 19-39, M=24.7, SD=5.86; 2 left-handed). Task structure identical to Exp1/2 (learning phase 3 x 20 s; 24 practice trials; 3 blocks x 90 = 270 test trials; z/m keys counterbalanced). Identity coding (author internal codes You/Neutral/AntiYou): You = Self (self-associated stranger's face), AntiYou = Self (own face, associated with a stranger's name), Neutral = Stranger. Data: 24 subjects x 270 test trials = 6480 rows. ACC: 1 correct / 0 incorrect / NA no response (key 'x'); RT_ms in ms, NA for no-response. Source: OSF 2q9w7, DATA/SelfBoostExp_3xxx.dat.
